eventStreams.name: TransactionStream
eventStreams.description: Real-time card and ACH transaction events
kqlAggregations: TransactionEvents | summarize TotalAmount=sum(Amount), TxnCount=count(), AvgAmount=avg(Amount) by TransactionType, bin(Timestamp, 1m)
TransactionEvents | summarize TotalAmount=sum(Amount), TxnCount=count() by Channel, bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: FraudDetection
eventStreams.description: ML-scored fraud detection events with risk scores
kqlAggregations: FraudDetectionEvents | where RiskScore > 0.8 | summarize AlertCount=count(), AvgRiskScore=avg(RiskScore), TotalAmount=sum(Amount) by AlertType, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
FraudDetectionEvents | summarize BlockedCount=countif(IsBlocked), TotalAlerts=count() by bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: ATMTelemetry
eventStreams.description: ATM device status, cash levels, and error events
kqlAggregations: ATMTelemetryEvents | summarize AvgCash=avg(CashLevel), MinCash=min(CashLevel), ErrorCount=countif(ErrorCode != "") by ATMID, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
ATMTelemetryEvents | where CashLevel < 20 | summarize LowCashATMs=dcount(ATMID), AvgCash=avg(CashLevel) by bin(Timestamp, 1h)

bridgeQueries.name: TransactionBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge hot real-time transactions with cold Lakehouse data

bridgeQueries.name: FraudBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge fraud detection events with historical fraud alerts
